title: 撤离
text:
到撤离点了。三张序章都过了。

{item:charm_brute}和{item:charm_sun}跟着包回{zone:仓库}，下一局带哪枚进去，就从哪位神开始。再往上的阶（{faith_threshold:brute:3}、{faith_threshold:brute:4}）有立即击败非首领敌人和不死，{ui:自由模式}里慢慢攒。

texts.en:
You've reached the extraction point. That's all three prologues done.

The {item:charm_brute} and the {item:charm_sun} go back to the {zone:仓库} with your bag. Whichever one you carry into the next run, that's the god you start with. The higher Ranks ({faith_threshold:brute:3}, {faith_threshold:brute:4}) bring instant kills on non-boss enemies, and a way to cheat death. Build up to them in {ui:自由模式}.
